scope: Independent peer review of final shared-union axiom tooling, full mapped-type/kernel graph planning, runtime identity guards and actual mapped-provider source replay.

checks.name: complete_shared_union
checks.finding: One initially empty visited/axiom state traverses every requested target. Sharing visited nodes only avoids duplicate recursion; the final complete union contains every target axiom closure. Union contained in the standard-three allowlist therefore establishes the same restriction for each target.

checks.name: checked_kernel_private_and_type_recursion
checks.finding: Read the installed Lean4.19.0 CollectAxioms: it reads checked kernel ConstantInfo and follows definition/theorem/opaque types and values, constructor/recursor types, and inductive types plus constructors. Private names are not filtered from this axiom traversal.

checks.name: six_adversarial_guard_tests
checks.finding: Both production guard forms pass clean shared-private/opaque dependencies exercising all standard-three axioms, reject a forbidden proof axiom through private theorem and opaque value, and reject a separate forbidden axiom occurring only in target types. Both expected exit sequences[0,1,1] occurred; unused unrelated test axioms were excluded. Reconstructible fixture bytes and actual logs are copied into this evidence directory.

checks.name: exact_public_and_private_lookup
checks.finding: Exact requested strings are resolved dynamically in the imported environment, preserving numeric private components. Missing names throw in the final harness; unresolved or ambiguous extra providers fail without silently dropping a target. Presence and final export require exactly the requested name set.

checks.name: fully_printed_types_and_actual_graph
checks.finding: Current renderer and Root Dependencies set pp.all true. Actual ConstantInfo type/value constants determine direct dependencies. Project recursion includes RectangleCLT/GenericChaining/Kane and their private names. The project graph filter does not narrow the axiom collector; pinned upstream Mathlib cannot introduce a path back to later project namespaces.

checks.name: mapped_provider_force_completeness
checks.finding: Actual kernel imported modules are exported by ProviderPresence after explicit extras. Runtime requires every actual mapped provider to have a pinned source; forces all such providers, including imported legacy/foundation/GenericChaining/Kane modules, plus the ArxivV1 Root/extra closure; and reconciles the final export provider set. Textual provider guesses are not treated as proof evidence.

checks.name: clean_source_and_command_guards
checks.finding: Execution checks a clean checkout at the exact plan commit, unchanged tool bytes, selected source/ledger hashes before/after, and fails closed on missing final sources. Every actual subprocess exit and hashed log is recorded, with failure receipts preserved. Root/Audit are never edited by the mapper.

checks.name: dependency_revisions_and_lean_version
checks.finding: Before/after checks enforce exact manifest git HEADs and clean tracked package sources for Mathlib and every git dependency; actual Lean version must match lean-toolchain. Independent current10-package identity checks pass; isolated negative tests reject wrong revision and tracked-source drift.

checks.name: current_import_source_inventory
checks.finding: Independent scan of the current1477-module corpus found no duplicate project module names or indented/multiple-module import lines. The parser captures this current corpus; missing project imports and actual provider-to-pinned-source failures block runtime rather than reducing the target list.

checks.name: historical_metadata_and_actual_legacy_dependencies
checks.finding: The superseded lower-width draft and archive_candidate baseline metadata are explicitly classified with preserved provenance; checked archived_declaration_candidates remain targets. Actual kernel dependencies have no blanket legacy-CLT exclusion. The lower scalar Berry--Esseen foundation bounded-CLT specialization is disclosed, and endpoint-specific no-legacy obligations remain separate.

checks.name: exact_c2_prose_classification
checks.finding: The sole non-name C2 prose item is recognized only by its exact value and JSON pointer, with pinned ledger identity and Root-confirmed classification. All3 checked supersession endpoints are requested. Other malformed target-bearing strings remain unresolved and prevent execution.

checks.name: provisional_full_plan_hash_checks
checks.finding: The final-precommit plan requests1949 distinct names from77 ledger inputs, with zero unresolved names/imports. All1126 selected source/config hashes and77 ledger hashes currently match. This checks planning completeness, not execution of the final1949-name clean run.

checks.name: fresh_current_renderer_execution
checks.finding: Independently executed the exact current provider-presence and full-type/axiom-union harnesses for4 public/private/Kane targets. Both commands actually exited0; exact generated bytes, all4 names, true provider identities,371 graph nodes, Kane nodes and standard-three union were checked from fresh output.

checks.name: current_root_audit_and_dependency_guards
checks.finding: Read the current Root Audit and Dependencies implementations. Both retain all enumerated targets, collect the complete shared axiom union and strictly check the allowlist; Dependencies includes pp.all and Kane/private-Kane. Production file hashes have advanced since the child fixture source read, while these tested guard expressions remain unchanged; this primary review binds the current full production bytes.

limitations: This approves the reviewed tooling and focused tests. The final clean checkout/full mapping run has not executed as part of this peer review and requires its own successful build/source-force/type/axiom/source-stability receipt.

The plan is explicitly precommit: execution refuses a different final commit or source/ledger/tool drift and requires regeneration after final integration. Target counts can change legitimately in that regeneration.
The union proves allowed axioms for every target; it does not claim separately recomputed per-target axiom lists. Kernel graph/type evidence and semantic passage acceptance remain separate.
